content_of_post_to_answer: Where do you usually sit when you want to get your most important work done?
answer: I get my most important work done where I can control interruptions, usually at a desk away from foot traffic and notifications. But I've noticed that the location matters less than what it signals to my brain. Sitting in the same place consistently for demanding work creates an association between that spot and concentration. The real advantage isn't having a perfect workspace; it's not having to negotiate with yourself every time you sit down.
